skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants a deep-dive analysis of a single A-share stock — answering "why did this stock move, what story is the market pricing in, where does it sit in the value chain, and how does it compare to the true core peers," plus a full-dimensional read (technical + capital flow + fundamentals + narrative logic). Trigger on phrases like "诊断 XX", "深挖 XX", "XX 今天为什么涨", "XX 炒什么逻辑", "XX 逻辑拆解", "XX 和 XX 比谁更正宗". Internal detailed mode only (names the stock, gives key levels) — no public/desensitized variant. All conclusions must be grounded in real data pulled from tdx / westock-data / neodata — never from memory. Output is twofold: a natural-language diagnostic report AND an ECharts HTML dashboard (real K-line candlestick, capital-flow bars, revaluation radar, peer-comparison bars, chain-value bars, evidence-audit tags) generated by render_report.py.
skills.description_zh:
个股深度诊断（A股） —— 由「西米」开发的 A 股个股深度分析 Skill。

【功能定位】
针对单只 A 股标的，从真实数据出发做全维度诊断：这只票为什么涨/跌、市场在炒什么逻辑、它处在产业链哪一环、与真正核心的同概念标的相比谁更正宗。覆盖技术面 + 资金面 + 基本面 + 叙事逻辑四维，并给出交易锚点（龙头 / 中军 / 对标 / 板块指数）和证据审计（已证实 / 推断 / 待验证），结论全部锚定真实数据，不凭空编造。

【怎么用】
在对话里直接说：「诊断 哈药股份」「深挖 贵州茅台」「XX 今天为什么涨」「XX 炒什么逻辑」「XX 和 XX 比谁更正宗」。Skill 会自动调用通达信、腾讯自选股、NeoData 等数据源，拉取真实行情、K 线、资金流向、龙虎榜、财报、公告、新闻后生成诊断，不依赖记忆。
skills.name: 个股深度诊断Pro
